CityGenerator.name: City Generator
CityGenerator.description: Procedural pipe network using orthogonal L-System rules

Hilbert3D.name: 3D Hilbert Curve
Hilbert3D.description: Space-filling curve visualization demonstrating efficient 3D traversal
Hilbert3D.qfep_connection: A 1D path that visits every point in 3D space — maximum E(S) coverage from minimum F-description. The curve's grammar rule is tiny; the space it fills is infinite. Recursion as F-compression of complexity.

AnimatedTree.name: Animated Tree Growth
AnimatedTree.description: Time-sliced L-System interpretation showing organic growth animation
AnimatedTree.qfep_connection: Grammar rules as F generating E(S) over time — a tiny production rule unfolds into a branching tree. Branching angle IS the λ parameter: small angle = ordered growth, large angle = sprawling chaos.

ForestCompetition.name: Forest Ecosystem
ForestCompetition.description: Multiple L-System trees with competing growth strategies and health mechanics
ForestCompetition.qfep_connection: Competition as multi-agent F-minimization — each tree's growth strategy (its F-model) competes for shared resources. The ecosystem emerges from local growth rules interacting through environmental constraints.

ContextSensitiveTree.name: Context-Sensitive Tree
ContextSensitiveTree.description: L-System tree with physics-based environmental awareness and branch pruning
ContextSensitiveTree.qfep_connection: Context-sensitive rules mean the system's F-model adapts to its environment — branches grow toward light, prune in shadow. Local-to-global coherence: each module responds to context while maintaining grammatical structure.

parametric_lsystem.name: Parametric L-System
parametric_lsystem.description: L-system with continuous angle and length parameters — branch depth controls parametric decay for organic, naturalistic tree and plant forms. More organic than discrete rules.

space_filling_curve_gallery.name: Space-Filling Curve Gallery
space_filling_curve_gallery.description: Triptych of classic space-filling curves — Hilbert, Peano, and Moore — generated via L-system rules and turtle graphics on a floor display. Curves that visit every point in a 2D region.
space_filling_curve_gallery.qfep_connection: Space-filling curves achieve maximum E(S) coverage — a 1D line that touches every point in 2D space. The grammar that generates them is minimal (low F); the pattern they produce is total (high E(S)). Dimension-transcending order.

branching_coral.name: Branching Coral
branching_coral.description: Marine L-system coral colony — multiple shoots with wide branching angles produce organic fan and staghorn forms. Color gradient from deep purple-brown base to bright pink coral tips on a rock base.
